scope: Independent static and numerical review of P5 SSBO packing and film state/camera/callout conventions. Geometry and native physics are covered by separate reports.

numeric_transport.literal_parser: Recognized float/int vectors and scalars only; rejects expression residue and element-count mismatch.
numeric_transport.float_conversion: Original literals converted to float32; integer literals converted to int32; explicit little-endian numeric arrays.
numeric_transport.layout: std430 scalar stride 4, vec2 stride 8, vec3/vec4 stride 16; correct per-table base alignment and final block padding.
numeric_transport.driver_check: EGL compares reflected total block bytes plus active member offsets/array strides with packed layout before upload.
numeric_transport.rendering_inputs: No triangle meshes or geometry/material textures. The RGBA32F texture is a render destination.
numeric_transport.portable_path: Downloadable live/replay GLSL retains all constants. Desktop film uses read-only std430 SSBO transport; the offline WebGL2 viewer can select exact std140 uvec4 uniform-buffer transport.

physical_state_review.units: SI input, millimetre local CAD, render unit = 200 mm; Y up; normalized WXYZ quaternion.
physical_state_review.fields: Six joint values from frame[1:7], jaw half gaps [13:15], independent puck position [15:18], quaternion [18:22].
physical_state_review.interpolation: Linear joint/gap/position interpolation; quaternion normalized lerp with consistent hemisphere.
physical_state_review.first_chapter: Nominal physical trace with inspection offsets/cut/extra mechanism phase zero.
physical_state_review.later_chapters: Explicit INSPECTION VIEW; frozen or selectively varied physical coordinates plus separate demonstration transforms.
physical_state_review.film_camera: World-space camera projection agrees with the fragment camera. Stable per-chapter fit envelopes avoid zoom breathing. Raw CAD bounds feed framing; rotating/exploded solids retain conservative runtime trace bounds.
physical_state_review.callouts: Current six-drive and gripper label tokens resolve to actual modeled records. Static envelopes and output hardware use the corresponding body pose; current tokens do not label a parent-side rotating input key. If such a callout is added, its physical input phase must also be applied.
physical_state_review.supplier_scope: Vendor envelopes are not presented as fully modeled internal mechanisms.

resolved_findings.finding: SSBO lacked the final 12 bytes of block padding although all member offsets were correct.
resolved_findings.resolution: Packer pads to 16 bytes; EGL now verifies GL_BUFFER_DATA_SIZE as well as member layout.

resolved_findings.finding: Group 11 title claimed forks, but forks belong to wrist drive groups.
resolved_findings.resolution: Title now says Links and load path.

resolved_findings.finding: Gripper inspection footer referred to a contact-held payload although group 7 does not display the payload.
resolved_findings.resolution: Footer now says MECHANISM INSPECTION · RECORDED JAW POSITIONS.

resolved_findings.finding: Film cache/join provenance originally omitted table packer code and some sampling settings.
resolved_findings.resolution: Current code records table_packer_sha256 and compares camera_samples, shadow_samples and quality on join and resume.

resolved_findings.finding: Broad P4-to-P5 replacement changed the film button label to Save MP5.
resolved_findings.resolution: Builder explicitly restores Save MP4; verified in current build script.

remaining_limited_caveats.item: The optional --no-caption flag is not included in film cache/join identity.
remaining_limited_caveats.effect: Reusing a chapter after changing only this flag can reuse the previous caption choice. The delivery defaults consistently enable captions.

remaining_limited_caveats.item: Resume and join trust a complete chapter report and do not recompute the chapter MP4 output_sha256 before reuse.
remaining_limited_caveats.effect: A separately edited or corrupted chapter could retain a stale report. No such change was observed in this review.

remaining_limited_caveats.item: First browser draw on software WebGL may have a long shader JIT delay.
remaining_limited_caveats.effect: Root added a separate 300-second first-probe allowance while keeping ordinary tile timeouts shorter. The final HTML hash needs its own completed P5 browser report.

delivery_checks: Rebuild replay and viewer after the final trace/shader freeze; join completed chapters and embed final film before the complete viewer test. Do not treat preliminary film-free HTML or historical P3 reports as final evidence.

further_unimplemented_optimizations.idea: Defer normal, tangent and local-material evaluation until the closest primary hit is final.
further_unimplemented_optimizations.basis: traceObject currently performs four SDF normal samples for each provisional nearest hit; an occluded provisional hit need not be shaded.
further_unimplemented_optimizations.validation: Keep the same hit epsilon and normal stencil for the final winning solid; compare complete float and encoded images.

further_unimplemented_optimizations.idea: Cache camera-relative light bases and constant quadrature sample positions/radiance once per frame.
further_unimplemented_optimizations.basis: Light orientation and the cloth radiance at the fixed 25 quadrature nodes are frame invariants.
further_unimplemented_optimizations.validation: Preserve numeric literals and operation order where feasible; check multiple camera and emitter placements. Compiler hoisting may already remove some cost.

further_unimplemented_optimizations.basis: The current threaded traversal has fixed ordering; earlier foreground hits could shorten later ray ranges.
further_unimplemented_optimizations.validation: Requires traversal changes and tie-order checks; no geometry simplification. Deferred beyond this frozen revision.

webgl_uniform_buffers.correctness: No numerical transport correctness issue found. All selected per-table scalar hashes match desktop tables; every generated accessor was independently tested.
webgl_uniform_buffers.packing: float32/int32 literal bits; four scalar or two vec2 elements per uvec4; vec3 padded to four lanes; 16-byte table alignment.
webgl_uniform_buffers.accessors: Global word address dispatch across named uniform blocks; uintBitsToFloat for floats; signed integer constructors for int/ivec; nested table indexing rewritten recursively; selected .length() calls retain original counts.
webgl_uniform_buffers.selection: Largest supported maximum block size with sufficient MAX_FRAGMENT_UNIFORM_BLOCKS; otherwise original literal shader source.
webgl_uniform_buffers.upload_validation: Active block size reflection and exact byte readback.
webgl_uniform_buffers.probe_scope: Generated std140 accessors on desktop OpenGL; browser execution and cross-driver images are separate reports.
